text:
incident-bot: Pager: HIGH GPU_DEPLETION in cluster us-west-2 — autoscaler failing to meet target, queueing and 502s reported. Impacting model: redwood/llm-1-large (primary). Investigating now.

oncall-alex: I’m on it. grabbing logs and handoff to ben.

ben-sre: seeing a surge of tailing short-lived jobs that exhausted thin pool. autoscaler failed to add nodes because quota error from cloud provider.

ben-sre: quick mitigation: shifting non-critical traffic to fallback model variant (llm-1-small) and throttling batch sizes. Pushing a policy to router.

ops-bot: Executed traffic-shift -> route set for service/ml-gen: fallback=llm-1-small, percent=30%.

carla-pm: Mary, any customer reports yet?

mary-cs: A few customers flagged increased 502s and timeouts, mostly interactive chat flows. CS triaged 3 customers as degraded (SLO risk). notified Sales.

oncall-alex: Applying emergency quota bump request with cloud-ops. If quota granted, we'll scale up and drain excess queue.

ben-sre: Command I ran to bump min replicas and reduce batching (temp):
```bash
redwoodctl autoscaler update --cluster us-west-2 --min-replicas 8 --max-replicas 40
kubectl patch deployment llm-1-large --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"llm","env":[{"name":"REDWOOD_BATCH_MAX","value":"8"}]}]}}}}' -n inference
```

incident-bot: Status update: quota request pending (cloud-ops ticket #CO-4578). router fallback active. Error rate trending down from 8% -> 2% over last 6m.

sre-lead: Good containment. Once quota confirmed and new nodes join, validate KV cache warmup to avoid regen thundering.

ben-sre: Nodes are joining (3/5). starting slow warmup: set warmup throttle to 10rps.

incident-bot: Stabilized: error rate 0.9%, latency P95 back to target. Officially out of active page.

carla-pm: Thanks team. Let's schedule a post-incident review — include root cause, timeline, customer impact, and action items for capacity forecasting and autoscaler fail-safes.

ben-sre: Proposed action items (short/mid/long):
- Short (owner: ben-sre, due: 72h): add circuit-breaker on submit queue to prevent thin-pool exhaustion; add synthetic load test to catch surge patterns.
- Mid (owner: oncall-alex, due: 14d): verify autoscaler error handling path; retry/backoff for quota errors and fallback to cross-region spillover.
- Long (owner: sre-lead, due: 60d): implement cross-region warm standby with automated traffic shift and KV cache prepopulation; improve capacity forecasting alerts.

mary-cs: I'll coordinate customer comms. draft message to affected customers by EOD.

oncall-alex: I'll create the postmortem doc and link the cloud-ops ticket. Jira: RED-INC-3421. Inviting ben-sre, carla-pm, and sre-lead.

carla-pm: Also want an item for the Router team to add visibility into fallback routing percentages per customer (owner: carla-pm, due: 7d).

ben-sre: added to action list.

sre-lead: Quick checklist for postmortem: timeline, logs (autoscaler + cloud quota responses), replay of traffic-shift, customer impact summary (CS input), and remediation plan with owners and dates.

incident-bot: Postmortem scheduled: RED-INC-3421 — Review meeting: 3/4/2026 10:00 PDT. Calendar invite sent.

carla-pm: thanks. closing this channel for active mitigation; will follow up in the postmortem thread for remediation tracking. :white_check_mark:

ben-sre: quick note — we should add automated smoke after nodes join to validate KV cache hit-rate. add as short action (ben-sre).

mary-cs: CS will attach customer impact notes to the Jira.

incident-bot: Thread archived. If any regressions appear, reopen or create a new incident thread.
